settings.heading: Our 30-day return policy
settings.subheading: Not the right fit? We've got you covered.
settings.highlight_text: 30 days to request a return from when you receive your order
settings.eligibility_text: To be eligible for a return, your item must be in the same condition that you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging. You'll also need the receipt or proof of purchase.
settings.how_text: Contact us at s77506910@gmail.com to request a return. If accepted, we'll send you a return shipping label and instructions on how and where to send your package. Items sent back without first requesting a return will not be accepted.
settings.damages_text: Please inspect your order upon reception and contact us immediately if the item is defective, damaged, or if you receive the wrong item, so we can evaluate the issue and make it right.
settings.exceptions_text: Unfortunately, we cannot accept returns on sale items or gift cards. Please get in touch if you have questions about a specific item.
settings.eu_text: If your order is shipped into the European Union, you have the right to cancel or return your order within 14 days, for any reason, without a justification. Your item must still be in the same condition you received it, unworn or unused, with tags, and in its original packaging.
settings.refund_text: We'll notify you once we've received and inspected your return, and let you know if it's approved. If approved, you'll be automatically refunded on your original payment method within 10 business days. It can take extra time for your bank or card provider to post the refund.
settings.footer_text: Questions about a return? Email s77506910@gmail.com and we'll help sort it out.

settings.question: Which joints does it fit?
settings.answer: Knees, elbows and shoulders — the wide adjustable straps let the wrap sit snugly on each. The pair set covers two joints at once.

settings.question: How warm does it get?
settings.answer: Three settings: 45°C, 50°C and 65°C. Start low and build up — the middle setting is plenty for most people.

settings.question: How long does the battery last?
settings.answer: The built-in 4000mAh rechargeable battery is designed for cordless use around the house; recharge it between sessions like a phone.

settings.question: Is this a medical device?
settings.answer: No — Thermawell is a comfort device, not a medical treatment. If you have a health concern, an injury, reduced skin sensitivity, or you’re pregnant, please speak to your GP before using heat products.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: A 30-day money-back guarantee on every order — contact us and we’ll sort a refund, no questions asked.
